metadata.label: negative
metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: A photorealistic outdoor street scene during a light rain shower. Raindrops fall vertically, but the puddles on the asphalt form sharp, upward-pointing conical peaks instead of flat reflective surfaces, cinematic lighting, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: Puddles cannot naturally form upward-pointing cones due to gravity and surface tension.
